# Barttery 1.2.5
- Fixes a crash on macOS 27 when nearby Apple devices (AirPods, iPhone, iPad) sent Bluetooth proximity advertisements. - Widgets now refresh their device list promptly when devices appear or disappear, without exhausting WidgetKit's refresh budget. - Improves Logitech Bluetooth (BLE) HID++ detection by preferring the HID++ collection and normalizing BLE input report IDs. Adds more detailed Logitech diagnostics to Console. - If a Logitech device still does not appear, quit Logi Options+ or disable Karabiner-Elements' "Modify events" for that device, then restart Barttery.
Includes the desktop widget and Sparkle in-app updates. Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
Logitech HID++ readings require Input Monitoring permission for Barttery. Users of 1.2.0 and earlier must update manually or through Homebrew.

# Barttery 1.2.4
- Adds HID++ battery support for MX Vertical devices reporting Bluetooth product ID `0xB020`. Thanks to @thoemmi. - Replaces the header Refresh button with the current app version, linking to the GitHub repository without changing the cursor on hover. - Removes the link from the app name in the header. - Updates the README logo.
Includes the desktop widget and Sparkle in-app updates.
Logitech HID++ readings require Input Monitoring permission for Barttery. Users of 1.2.0 and earlier must update manually or through Homebrew.

# Barttery 1.2.3
- Fixes Logitech charging-only responses and keeps the lightning indicator visible for a fully charged device reporting its full-on-charger status, including at 100%. - Improves Apple Watch charger-transition monitoring without trusting stale registry flags or expiring state during an uninterrupted live event stream. - Fixes accessory notifications and preserves battery measurement timestamps. - Includes device-helper packaging fixes, the desktop widget, and Sparkle in-app updates.
**Logitech charging detection requires Input Monitoring permission for Barttery:** System Settings → Privacy & Security → Input Monitoring. Restart Barttery after changing permission.
Users of 1.2.0 and earlier must update manually or through Homebrew.

# Barttery 1.2.1
- Adds Sparkle in-app updates. When an update is found, **Update Available…** appears below **Launch at Login**. Click it to review and install the update. - Adds a Liquid Glass application icon for macOS 26 and later, with a static fallback for older macOS versions. - Includes the desktop battery widget and existing Logitech battery monitoring improvements.
Version 1.2.0 users must install this release manually or through Homebrew to enable future in-app updates.
